prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1452; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented with lumbar strain following a sideswipe collision during a lane change. The reported mechanism is consistent with the injury pattern observed on examination, and the findings are in keeping with the force described at the scene. Initial management included rest, anti-inflammatory medication, and guided physical therapy. Over the course of 22 visits, symptoms gradually improved in a manner typical for this type of soft tissue injury, and the frequency of visits was reduced as function returned. Lumbar imaging and clinical examination clearly confirm the strain, with muscle guarding and reduced range of motion documented at presentation. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment to the lower back, and no earlier records of this body region were identified. Billing records reflect single entries for each service rendered, without duplicated charges. At last assessment the patient had regained most of their baseline function and was discharged to a home exercise program with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
